== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Orus fruit is a white, peach-like fruit that grows on trees with purple leaves. While standard varieties are native to [[Sacred Valley]] and valued by outsiders as a delicacy for their unique flavor, they possess no magical properties. However, fruit harvested from an [[ancestral orus tree]] is classified as a [[spirit-fruit]]. This rare version contains immense amounts of purified [[vital aura]] that can be converted into [[madra]], providing enough energy to potentially save a person's life or enable the activation of specific abilities. [[Consuming]] this ancestral fruit is a significant process that can take several days to digest, and the experience of eating it has been described as feeling like swallowing a thunderbolt.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The orus fruit is a white [[spirit-fruit]] that bears a resemblance to a pure white peach. During his efforts to restore the fruit, [[Lindon]] experienced its intense effects, which involve sensations of alternating heat and cold similar to swallowing a thunderbolt. This [[spirit-fruit]] can be cycled to allow for the integration of its [[madra]]. Ultimately, the power contained within the orus fruit treasure was incorporated into [[Lindon]]'s own power.}}
